findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "enrich" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enrich_preview, get_premium_access · Private data: resolve_company, enrich_preview, verify_email_preview, get_premium_access · Public sink: enrich_preview, verify_email_preview, get_premium_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enrich_preview, get_premium_access · Private data: resolve_company, enrich_preview, verify_email_preview, get_premium_access · Public sink: enrich_preview, verify_email_preview, get_premium_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
